title: AdapterCapabilities
description: Capabilities that an adapter declares before launching a child. A capability the request requires and the adapter does not declare is rejected or ends in launch_failed.

harness_name.description: Identifier of the harness the adapter drives: lowercase identifier starting with a letter.

harness_version.description: Version of the harness as reported by the harness itself.

agent_selection.description: The adapter can select an agent per launch.

interactive_permissions.description: The harness asks for permissions that the adapter can answer.

cancellation.description: The adapter can cancel the live turn of the child.

usage_reporting.description: The harness reports token usage and cost.

agent_selection_mode.description: How the harness selects an agent: a per-launch primary override, a native agent list, or no selection.
